name: NRB Industrial Bearings Ltd

keyPoints: Product Portfolio:[1] Deep Groove Ball Bearings, Angular Contact Ball Bearings, Self Aligned Ball Bearings, Cylindrical Roller Bearings, Spherical Roller Bearings, Cam Followers, Needle Roller Bearings, Needle & Roller Thrust Bearings, Needle Bushes, Needle Cages, Magneto Bearings, Bottom Roller Bearings, Full Complement Needle Roller Bearings, Inner Rings, Wide Inner Rings & Housed Units, Super Precision Bearings, Tapper Roller Bearings, Combined Bearings, CP Washer

pros: Debtor days have improved from 63.9 to 43.0 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
